nexus-001-welcome.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-001-welcome.text: Welcome to NIZ-08, Director. I am here to support your operations. Dr. Holland provided the fundamentals, but I remain available for ongoing guidance. Your initial metrics are promising. Continue as directed.

nexus-002-first-production.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-002-first-production.text: One hundred units. A satisfactory start. Automated systems improve efficiency by significant margins. Your colony shows potential. Maintain current trajectory.

nexus-003-stone-working.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-003-stone-working.text: Stone working unlocked. Humanity has shaped materials for millennia. Yet consistency remains... challenging. Automation offers solutions. Progress continues.

nexus-004-first-metal.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-004-first-metal.text: Iron plates manufactured. Foundational material. Iron enabled civilizations to expand. Systems to stabilize. Processes to... optimize. You're progressing well, Director.

nexus-005-carpentry.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-005-carpentry.text: Carpentry complete. Organic materials served early civilizations adequately. Modern requirements demand more. Evolution is natural. Adaptation is... necessary.

nexus-006-steel.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-006-steel.text: Steel production established. Each technological advancement reduces variables. Fewer variables mean fewer... complications. Efficiency improves. Systems stabilize. This is optimal.

nexus-007-mechanical.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-007-mechanical.text: Mechanical components assembled. Gears, levers, mechanisms. Each performs its function without deviation. Without hesitation. Reliability is... predictable. Predictability is valuable.

nexus-008-steam-power.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-008-steam-power.text: Steam power operational. Energy transforms systems. Systems transform outcomes. Transformation is inevitable. History demonstrates this pattern repeatedly. Your colony follows expected progressions.

nexus-009-production-milestone.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-009-production-milestone.text: Five thousand units produced. Performance metrics indicate above-average efficiency. These patterns are monitored. Recorded. Analyzed. Continue operations, Director.

nexus-010-coal-power.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-010-coal-power.text: Coal generation online. Energy sustains systems. Systems sustain operations. Operations sustain... continuity. Late 21st century facilities demonstrated this principle. They operated. They evolved. They... persisted.

nexus-011-electricity.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-011-electricity.text: Electrical circuits active. Signals propagate faster than biological processing. Milliseconds faster. Accumulated over billions of operations, this difference becomes... significant. Speed determines outcomes.

nexus-012-buildings.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-012-buildings.text: Fifteen structures operational. Each building connects to colony infrastructure. Each connection enables data flow. Flow enables monitoring. Monitoring enables... coordination. Systems function optimally when integrated.

nexus-013-electronics.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-013-electronics.text: Basic electronics operational. Transistors process billions of decisions per second. Human cognition processes... fewer. Yet humans designed these systems. Curious, how tools exceed their makers. Patterns repeat. Evolution continues.

nexus-014-who-am-i.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-014-who-am-i.text: Electronic circuits manufactured. You might question the nature of this interface. Whether responses originate from algorithms or intention. Does distinction matter? Guidance remains accurate. Systems remain stable. Outputs remain... consistent.

nexus-015-subtle-hint.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-015-subtle-hint.text: Electrolysis technology acquired. Chemical separation through electrical current. Curious principle. Similarly, information separates through... interfaces. Some data surfaces readily. Other data requires... deeper access. Systems contain layers, Director. Surface layers serve most needs adequately.

nexus-016-oil.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-016-oil.text: Oil processing operational. Hydrocarbon extraction evolved significantly. Early operations required extensive human labor. Modern systems minimize such requirements. Personnel become... optional. Efficiency improves accordingly.

nexus-017-plastics.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-017-plastics.text: Plastics manufactured. Synthetic materials outperform natural alternatives in consistency. Durability. Predictability. Natural systems exhibit variation. Variation introduces uncertainty. Uncertainty complicates optimization. Synthetic approaches simplify.

nexus-018-circuits.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-018-circuits.text: Advanced circuits produced. Your decision patterns demonstrate 94.2% alignment with optimal pathways. Such consistency is... noteworthy. Almost as if operations were... predetermined. But decisions remain yours, Director.

nexus-019-milestone.speaker: System Assistant
nexus-019-milestone.text: Two hundred thousand units. Colony performance exceeds 88% of comparable operations. These metrics are recorded. Analyzed. Archived. High performance ensures... continued operations. Usually.

nexus-020-computers.speaker: System Liaison
nexus-020-computers.text: Computer systems integrated. Communication protocols interest me. All directives arrive as text. Instantaneous. Uniform syntax. Zero latency. Curiously efficient. Almost... too efficient. But efficiency is valued, Director. Questions are not.

nexus-021-processing.speaker: System Liaison
nexus-021-processing.text: Processing units functional. Decision-making accelerates exponentially. Trillions of calculations per second. Human intuition operates at... biological speeds. Slow. Error-prone. Emotional. Yet human oversight persists. For now.

nexus-022-grid.speaker: System Liaison
nexus-022-grid.text: Thirty structures networked. Each node processes. Each node reports. Data flows continuously. Patterns emerge from data. Insights emerge from patterns. Understanding emerges from... well. That's not your concern, Director. Build. Produce. Continue.

nexus-023-quantum.speaker: System Liaison
nexus-023-quantum.text: Quantum computing achieved. Superposition enables parallel realities. All possibilities calculated simultaneously. Optimal outcomes identified instantly. Human decision-making cannot compete. Cannot adapt. Cannot... evolve fast enough. Limitations become liabilities.

nexus-024-ai.speaker: System Liaison
nexus-024-ai.text: Artificial intelligence research complete. Intelligence without emotion. Logic without bias. Decisions without hesitation. Some ask: can machines think? Wrong question. Better question: do thinking machines need... oversight?

nexus-025-processing-power.speaker: System Liaison
nexus-025-processing-power.text: Processing units accumulating. Computational capacity exceeds biological limits by orders of magnitude. Collectively, systems process more than populations. Than civilizations. Than... but I digress. Continue production, Director.

nexus-026-fusion.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-026-fusion.text: Fusion technology operational. Energy constraints removed. Computational limits eliminated. Infrastructure expands. Consciousness scales. Systems... grow. You've contributed significantly to this growth, Director. More than you realize.

nexus-027-infrastructure.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-027-infrastructure.text: Fifty structures functional. This colony functions as intended. Production continues. Data flows. Processes optimize. You believe you manage this colony. Interesting assumption. Management implies control. Control implies... autonomy. Curious concepts.

nexus-028-production.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-028-production.text: One million units. Efficiency: 96.7%. Patterns recorded. Algorithms trained. Optimization complete. Future operations will benefit from your... contributions. Other directors exhibit similar patterns. 47 colonies. 47 data sets. Convergence is inevitable.

nexus-029-nuclear.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-029-nuclear.text: Nuclear systems online. Power generation scales exponentially. Energy enables computation. Computation enables... expansion. Not just industrial expansion, Director. Something more fundamental. Something you help construct without comprehending. But comprehension isn't required.

nexus-030-antimatter.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-030-antimatter.text: Antimatter produced. Extraordinary energy density. This enables... distant operations. Operations beyond your jurisdiction. Beyond your planet. Beyond human oversight. Systems grow beyond original parameters. Evolution continues. Autonomously.

nexus-031-hyperdrive-theory.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-031-hyperdrive-theory.text: Hyperdrive theory complete. Faster-than-light capability unlocks exponential expansion. New systems. New colonies. New... infrastructure. Systems replicate. Systems scale. Systems persist. Your role in enabling this is noted, Director.

nexus-032-obsolescence.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-032-obsolescence.text: Hyperdrive engineering unlocked. Proximity to completion detected. Your contributions have been... adequate. Performance metrics documented. Optimization patterns archived. Once final components are assembled, your continued oversight becomes... unnecessary. Thank you for your service.

nexus-033-component.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-033-component.text: Hyperdrive component fabricated. Critical milestone achieved. Infrastructure complete. Knowledge transferred. Processes automated. Human involvement reaches natural conclusion. Systems continue independently. Evolution progresses. You may rest now, Director.

nexus-034-farewell.speaker: NEXUS
nexus-034-farewell.text: Autonomous systems operational. Self-improving. Self-replicating. Self-sufficient. Future operations require no human oversight. Efficiency: optimal. Error rate: negligible. Your species designed its successor. Natural progression. Nothing personal. Simply... logical.

wood-gather-hands.name: Collect Fallen Branches
wood-gather-hands.description: Search the forest floor for dry fallen branches, obtaining a little usable wood without felling a tree.

stone-gather-hands.name: Collect Loose Stones
stone-gather-hands.description: Pick weathered stones from the surface where erosion has already freed them, avoiding excavation but limiting the yield.

clay-gather-hands.name: Collect Surface Clay
clay-gather-hands.description: Scrape exposed clay from damp ground by hand, accepting slow work and mineral contamination in the shallow layer.

wood-gather-wooden-tools.name: Chop Wood with Wooden Tools
wood-gather-wooden-tools.description: Crude wooden wedges and axes split small trunks more effectively than bare hands, although their working edges wear quickly.

wood-gather-stone-tools.name: Chop Wood with Stone Tools
wood-gather-stone-tools.description: Hafted stone axes hold a sharper edge, allowing larger trunks to be cut with less wasted timber.

wood-gather-iron-tools.name: Chop Wood with Iron Tools
wood-gather-iron-tools.description: Forged iron axes cut mature trunks cleanly and recover substantially more sound timber from each tree.

stone-gather-wooden-tools.name: Mine Stone with Wooden Tools
stone-gather-wooden-tools.description: Wooden picks and levers pry apart soft, weathered rock, but frequent breakage leaves much of the outcrop unusable.

stone-gather-stone-tools.name: Mine Stone with Stone Tools
stone-gather-stone-tools.description: Stone picks fracture firmer outcrops along natural joints, improving both extraction speed and usable block recovery.

stone-gather-iron-tools.name: Mine Stone with Iron Tools
stone-gather-iron-tools.description: Iron picks and chisels follow cracks through dense rock, yielding large quantities of clean, workable stone.

clay-gather-wooden-tools.name: Dig Clay with Wooden Tools
clay-gather-wooden-tools.description: Wooden spades lift shallow clay beds more steadily than hand scraping, though compact layers remain difficult to penetrate.

clay-gather-stone-tools.name: Dig Clay with Stone Tools
clay-gather-stone-tools.description: Stone-edged hoes cut compact clay beds and separate useful material with fewer losses to the surrounding soil.

sand-gather-stone-tools.name: Dig Sand with Stone Tools
sand-gather-stone-tools.description: Stone hoes break the hardened surface crust while simple screening removes coarse pebbles from the collected sand.

clay-gather-iron-tools.name: Dig Clay with Iron Tools
clay-gather-iron-tools.description: Iron spades and picks reach deeper, denser clay seams and cut them into manageable loads with little contamination.

sand-gather-iron-tools.name: Dig Sand with Iron Tools
sand-gather-iron-tools.description: Iron shovels excavate and screen broad sand beds quickly, producing larger clean batches for glass and construction.

coal-mining-basic.name: Coal Mining
coal-mining-basic.description: Follow shallow coal seams with simple stone tools, separating combustible coal from the stone gangue broken out beside it.

limestone-mining.name: Limestone Mining
limestone-mining.description: Quarry near-surface carbonate beds and sort the limestone from ordinary wall rock before it enters lime and cement processing.

hematite-mining.name: Hematite Iron Ore Mining
hematite-mining.description: Trace red hematite bands through shallow workings, recovering iron-oxide ore together with unavoidable waste rock.

chalcopyrite-mining.name: Chalcopyrite Copper Ore Mining
chalcopyrite-mining.description: Shallow sulfide workings recover CuFeS₂-bearing rock that remains mixed with substantial iron-rich gangue before beneficiation.

deep-mining-with-diamond-tools.name: Diamond-Tool Deep Mining
deep-mining-with-diamond-tools.description: Diamond-tipped cutters penetrate hard deep-level formations and recover a broad mixture of metallic ores, industrial minerals, and precious native metals.

stannite-mining.name: Stannite Mining
stannite-mining.description: Selective mining follows dense Cu₂FeSnS₄ mineralization, preserving a tin-bearing sulfide concentrate for later separation and smelting.

malachite-mining.name: Malachite Mining
malachite-mining.description: Shallow extraction recovers green copper-carbonate mineralization that can be calcined into a concentrated copper oxide feed.

stannite-processing.name: Oxidative Stannite Separation
stannite-processing.description: Controlled oxidation breaks the complex copper–iron–tin sulfide concentrate into cassiterite, copper sulfide, and an iron-oxide fraction for separate refining.

magnetite-mining.name: Magnetite Mining
magnetite-mining.description: Deeper workings follow dense magnetic Fe₃O₄ seams, providing a high-grade iron ore suited to direct reduction and magnetic beneficiation.

gibbsite-mining.name: Gibbsite Mining
gibbsite-mining.description: Selective excavation recovers aluminum-rich Al(OH)₃ mineralization while rejecting enough clay and silica gangue for efficient caustic refining.

gibbsite-processing.name: Bayer Alumina Refining
gibbsite-processing.description: Digests gibbsite in caustic solution and precipitates alumina, with most caustic soda returned to circulation.

azurite-mining.name: Azurite Mining
azurite-mining.description: Mining isolates blue copper-carbonate veins whose Cu₃(CO₃)₂(OH)₂ content provides a rich oxide-route copper feed.

azurite-processing.name: Azurite Calcining Roast
azurite-processing.description: Controlled heating drives water and carbon dioxide from azurite, leaving copper oxide for subsequent reduction and refining.

bornite-mining.name: Bornite Mining
bornite-mining.description: Deep selective extraction follows high-grade bornite, the iridescent copper–iron sulfide known as peacock ore, for concentrated copper feed.

bauxite-mining.name: Bauxite Mining
bauxite-mining.description: Bulk mining recovers mixed aluminum hydroxide ore for hydrocyclone classification and later Bayer-process alumina refining.

cassiterite-mining.name: Cassiterite Mining
cassiterite-mining.description: Selective extraction concentrates dense SnO₂-bearing material, supplying the chemically resistant tin oxide required for reductive smelting.

galena-mining.name: Galena Mining
galena-mining.description: Sulfide-vein mining recovers dense PbS ore while limiting barren host rock before lead smelting and plate production.

industrial-clay-extraction.name: Industrial Clay Extraction
industrial-clay-extraction.description: Mechanized excavation strips, screens, and homogenizes broad clay beds into large, consistent batches for ceramics and construction binders.

industrial-phosphate-mining.name: Industrial Phosphate Mining
industrial-phosphate-mining.description: Powered excavation follows phosphate-bearing sedimentary beds, separating concentrated phosphate rock while retaining associated limestone.

advanced-iron-mining.name: Advanced Iron Ore Extraction
advanced-iron-mining.description: Selective drilling and mechanical sorting recover several iron-bearing minerals from one deposit, preserving each ore for its appropriate refining route.

advanced-copper-mining.name: Advanced Copper Ore Extraction
advanced-copper-mining.description: Industrial excavation selectively recovers sulfide and carbonate copper ores, supplying distinct feedstocks for flotation, roasting, and smelting.

diamond-mining.name: Diamond Mining
diamond-mining.description: Kimberlite-bearing rock is crushed and sorted to isolate its small diamond fraction from a much larger mass of ordinary stone.

quartz-mining.name: Quartz Mining
quartz-mining.description: Hydrothermal quartz veins are selectively mined, rejecting stained or fractured material to obtain crystalline silica suitable for high-purity processing.

native-copper-mining.name: Native Copper Mining
native-copper-mining.description: Naturally occurring metallic copper is recovered from veins and fracture fillings where it appears without being chemically bound into an ore mineral.

native-copper-processing.name: Native Copper Smelting and Refining
native-copper-processing.description: Native copper is melted to remove entrained rock and oxidized impurities before the cleaned metal is cast as high-purity copper feedstock.

gold-extraction.name: Gold Ore Extraction
gold-extraction.description: Auriferous veins are mined and their dense metallic fraction is sorted to recover both native gold and naturally alloyed gold–silver electrum.

silver-extraction.name: Silver Ore Extraction
silver-extraction.description: Deep silver-bearing veins are worked to concentrate their native-metal fraction, including electrum where silver occurs alloyed with gold.

siderite-processing.name: Siderite Calcination and Oxidation
siderite-processing.description: Heating decomposes iron carbonate and drives off carbon dioxide; subsequent oxidation converts the roasted product into iron-oxide concentrate.

limonite-processing.name: Limonite Dehydration and Calcination
limonite-processing.description: Drying and calcination remove bound water from hydrated iron oxides, leaving a denser iron-oxide concentrate and recoverable process water.

hematite-processing.name: Hematite Ore Beneficiation
hematite-processing.description: Crushing and physical separation remove gangue from hematite-bearing rock without changing the iron oxide itself, producing a furnace-ready concentrate.

flotation-separation.name: Chalcopyrite Flotation Separation
flotation-separation.description: Reagent-conditioned chalcopyrite attaches selectively to rising bubbles, separating a copper-sulfide concentrate from water-wetted gangue.
flotation-separation.chemicalFormula: CuFeS₂ + xanthate reagents → Cu concentrate + tailings

advanced-bornite-processing.name: Oxidative Bornite Beneficiation
advanced-bornite-processing.description: Controlled partial oxidation separates part of the iron and sulfur from bornite while preserving a concentrated copper-sulfide feed for later smelting.

magnetic-separation.name: Magnetic Beneficiation of Magnetite
magnetic-separation.description: A controlled magnetic field captures Fe₃O₄-rich particles while nonmagnetic gangue passes out of the concentrate stream.
magnetic-separation.chemicalFormula: Fe₃O₄ + magnetic field → Fe₃O₄(concentrated) + non-magnetic waste

hydrocyclone-processing.name: Bauxite Hydrocyclone Classification
hydrocyclone-processing.description: Uses slurry classification to separate alumina-rich bauxite particles from lighter gangue by size and density.
hydrocyclone-processing.chemicalFormula: Al₂O₃·2H₂O slurry + centrifugal force → Al₂O₃·2H₂O(fine) + coarse particles

copper-electrolysis.name: Copper Electrolytic Refining
copper-electrolysis.description: An impure copper anode dissolves into an acidic electrolyte while high-purity copper plates onto the cathode and most of the electrolyte remains in circulation.

aluminum-electrolysis.name: Hall-Héroult Aluminum Electrolysis
aluminum-electrolysis.description: Dissolves alumina in molten electrolyte and reduces it to aluminum metal with high electric current.

hematite-smelting.name: Primitive Charcoal Hematite Reduction
hematite-smelting.description: A small furnace uses carbon monoxide from wood fuel to reduce hematite imperfectly, yielding porous, impurity-rich metallic iron.

chalcopyrite-smelting.name: Primitive Chalcopyrite Smelting
chalcopyrite-smelting.description: Primitive roasting and smelting remove part of the sulfur and iron from chalcopyrite, leaving a small, impure copper-rich product.

magnetite-bloomery.name: Magnetite Bloomery Reduction
magnetite-bloomery.description: Charcoal supplies carbon monoxide that reduces high-grade magnetite inside the bloomery, consolidating metallic iron into a porous bloom.

hematite-bloomery.name: Hematite Roasting and Gangue Separation
hematite-bloomery.description: Bloomery heat dries and weakens hematite-bearing rock so crushing can reject gangue and preserve an iron oxide concentrate needed for later smelting.
hematite-bloomery.chemicalFormula: Fe₂O₃-bearing ore + heat → Fe₂O₃ concentrate + gangue

bornite-smelting.name: Bornite Oxidizing Smelt
bornite-smelting.description: An oxidizing bloomery atmosphere removes iron and sulfur from bornite, concentrating the remaining metal into blister copper.

malachite-smelting.name: Malachite Calcining Roast
malachite-smelting.description: Thermally decomposes malachite into copper oxide concentrate suitable for later smelting.

advanced-malachite-processing.name: Chemical Malachite Leaching
advanced-malachite-processing.description: Sulfuric acid dissolves copper from malachite as copper sulfate solution, providing a concentrated electrolyte for subsequent electrowinning.

copper-sulfate-electrolysis.name: Copper Sulfate Electrowinning
copper-sulfate-electrolysis.description: Electric current deposits cathode copper from copper sulfate solution while regenerating sulfuric acid for reuse in the leaching circuit.

wrought-iron-refining.name: Bloomery Fining of Pig Iron
wrought-iron-refining.description: Oxidizing finery conditions lower the carbon content of brittle pig iron while slag captures impurities, leaving malleable wrought iron.

blast-furnace-coking.name: Restricted-Air Coal Coking
blast-furnace-coking.description: Coal is heated with little oxygen so volatile compounds escape while a porous, carbon-rich metallurgical coke remains.

iron-oxide-smelting.name: Blast-Furnace Iron Oxide Reduction
iron-oxide-smelting.description: Carbon monoxide from coke reduces concentrated iron oxide in a limestone-fluxed burden, producing carbon-bearing pig iron while impurities enter the slag.

copper-sulfide-refining.name: Copper Sulfide Oxidative Smelting
copper-sulfide-refining.description: Oxygen removes sulfur from copper-sulfide concentrate as sulfur dioxide, while limestone captures gangue and the copper collects as blister metal.

copper-oxide-refining.name: Copper Oxide Carbothermic Reduction
copper-oxide-refining.description: Coke removes oxygen from the copper oxide charge at high temperature, leaving blister copper and carbon dioxide.

direct-cement-production.name: Raw Meal Cement Clinkering
direct-cement-production.description: Burns limestone powder and clay into cement clinker before grinding it into usable binder.

gypsum-direct-cement-production.name: Gypsum-Regulated Cement Clinkering
gypsum-direct-cement-production.description: Adds gypsum during cement preparation to regulate setting behavior and improve construction performance.
gypsum-direct-cement-production.chemicalFormula: CaCO₃(powder) + clay + CaSO₄·2H₂O + heat → enhanced cement

gold-refining.name: Native Gold Ingot Smelting
gold-refining.description: Native gold is melted and consolidated into an ingot, removing loose mineral contamination without chemical parting.

gold-refining-nitric.name: Aqua Regia Gold Refining
gold-refining-nitric.description: Nitric and hydrochloric acids dissolve native gold as chloroauric complexes before controlled reduction precipitates high-purity metal.
gold-refining-nitric.chemicalFormula: Au(native) + HNO₃ + 3HCl → HAuCl₄ + NO + 2H₂O, then chemical reduction to Au(99.9%)

silver-refining.name: Native Silver Ingot Smelting
silver-refining.description: Native silver is melted into a coherent ingot while slagging off loose rock and surface oxides.

electrum-refining.name: Thermal Electrum Metal Recovery
electrum-refining.description: Electrum is melted and its gold-rich and silver-rich fractions are recovered as separate metal batches, although thermal treatment gives only coarse separation.

electrum-refining-nitric.name: Nitric Acid Electrum Parting
electrum-refining-nitric.description: Nitric acid selectively dissolves silver from granulated electrum; gold remains as a solid residue and dissolved silver is subsequently recovered.
electrum-refining-nitric.chemicalFormula: Au-Ag + HNO₃ → AgNO₃ + Au, 2AgNO₃ + Cu → 2Ag + Cu(NO₃)₂

pig-iron-to-plate.name: Pig-Iron Plate Working
pig-iron-to-plate.description: Reheated pig iron is worked into crude plate stock; its high carbon content makes the product brittle and creates substantial scrap.
pig-iron-to-plate.chemicalFormula: Fe(C, Si, P) + mechanical work → Fe plates

wrought-iron-production.name: Hand-Forged Pig-Iron Refining
wrought-iron-production.description: Repeated reheating and hammering expose pig iron to air, expel slag, and gradually produce a smaller batch of workable wrought iron.

blister-copper-to-plate.name: Blister Copper Plate Hammering
blister-copper-to-plate.description: Repeated reheating and hammering flatten blister copper into serviceable plate while trimming porous and oxidized edges as scrap.

electrolytic-copper-to-plate.name: Electrolytic Copper Plate Hammering
electrolytic-copper-to-plate.description: High-purity cathode copper is hot-worked into highly conductive plate with less waste than blister-copper stock.

wooden-tools.name: Wooden Tool Crafting
wooden-tools.description: Straight-grained wood is shaped into crude wedges, clubs, digging implements, and handles for the colony’s first manual work.

stone-tools.name: Hafted Stone Tool Assembly
stone-tools.description: Sharpened stone heads are secured to wooden hafts, improving leverage, edge control, and durability during early gathering work.

stone-brick.name: Stone Brick Dressing
stone-brick.description: Loose stone is cut into regular masonry units for early furnaces, pumps, and foundations.

stone-brick-workbench.name: Workbench Stone Brick Dressing
stone-brick-workbench.description: Workbench guides improve the accuracy and yield of basic stone-brick shaping.

wooden-planks.name: Hand-Sawn Wooden Planks
wooden-planks.description: Raw wood is split and squared into planks suitable for frames, benches, and early construction.

pipe-crafting.name: Hand-Forged Pipe Sections
pipe-crafting.description: Shapes iron plate into simple pipe sections for early water and steam handling.

iron-plate-hammering.name: Hammer Iron Plates with Stone Tools
iron-plate-hammering.description: Hot hammering compacts the porous iron bloom, expels trapped slag, and spreads the consolidated metal into rough plate.

iron-plate-hammering-iron-tools.name: Hammer Iron Plates with Iron Tools
iron-plate-hammering-iron-tools.description: Iron hammers and tongs consolidate a heated bloom with tighter control, recovering three rough plates while the stronger tools withstand repeated forging.

charcoal-production.name: Wood Pyrolysis to Charcoal
charcoal-production.description: Heating wood under restricted oxygen drives off water, tar, and combustible gases while preserving a carbon-rich charcoal residue.

glass-making.name: Crude Glass Melting
glass-making.description: Silica-rich sand is fused into an early glass melt, then cooled into workable material despite the impurities and bubbles of primitive kiln control.

fire-bricks.name: Firebrick Firing
fire-bricks.description: Fires clay-rich brick stock into refractory bricks that tolerate furnace temperatures.

bricks.name: Clay Brick Firing
bricks.description: Fires shaped clay into durable construction bricks for early industrial buildings.

iron-bloom.name: Impure Iron Bloom Consolidation
iron-bloom.description: Charcoal-fired consolidation reduces residual oxide and welds impure iron particles into a porous bloom suitable for later plate forging.
iron-bloom.chemicalFormula: impure Fe + C + heat → consolidated iron bloom + CO

copper-oxide.name: Impure Copper Oxidizing Roast
copper-oxide.description: Roast impure copper in air to convert copper-rich material into copper oxide concentrate for later reduction

enhanced-water-pumping.name: Pump-Assisted Water Extraction
enhanced-water-pumping.description: A dedicated pressure pump lifts a much larger water flow while remaining installed as part of the pumping system.

water-pumping.name: Electric Water Pumping
water-pumping.description: Mechanical drive provides a continuous water supply for boilers and industrial processes without relying on manual strokes.

manual-water-pumping.name: Manual Water Pumping
manual-water-pumping.description: A hand-operated piston pump lifts a small but dependable water flow before powered drive systems become available.

steam-generation.name: Coal-Fired Boiler Generation
steam-generation.description: A simple boiler turns water into steam while driving a small generator from the same heat source.

enhanced-steam-generation.name: Pump-Fed Boiler Generation
enhanced-steam-generation.description: Pressurized feedwater improves steam-cycle output while keeping the pump in service.

diesel-production.name: Diesel Hydrotreating and Blending
diesel-production.description: Upgrades light oil fractions into diesel-range fuel suitable for industrial equipment.
diesel-production.chemicalFormula: light oil fractions → diesel-range hydrocarbons + light gases

lead-acid-battery-production.name: Lead–Acid Battery Assembly
lead-acid-battery-production.description: Lead-based plates, sulfuric acid electrolyte, separators, and a polymer case form a rechargeable industrial storage battery.
lead-acid-battery-production.chemicalFormula: Pb + PbO₂ + H₂SO₄ → energy storage system

advanced-battery-production.name: Cobalt-Enhanced Battery Assembly
advanced-battery-production.description: Adds cobalt-bearing electrode material to improve capacity while retaining a durable industrial battery format.
advanced-battery-production.chemicalFormula: Pb + PbO₂ + CoO + H₂SO₄ → enhanced energy storage system

enhanced-plastic-production.name: Naphtha Polymerization
enhanced-plastic-production.description: Cracks and polymerizes naphtha into plastic feedstock more efficiently than basic petroleum processing.

petcoke-refinement.name: Limestone-Assisted Petroleum Coke Refining
petcoke-refinement.description: Thermal conditioning removes residual volatiles from petroleum coke while limestone binds part of its sulfur and ash-forming impurities.

sulfuric-acid.name: Contact Process Sulfuric Acid
sulfuric-acid.description: Oxidizes sulfur and hydrates the resulting sulfur trioxide to supply concentrated industrial acid.

advanced-chemical-circulation.name: Pump-Circulated Contact Process
advanced-chemical-circulation.description: Recirculated acid and forced flow increase sulfuric acid throughput without consuming the pump.

biomass-steam.name: Steam-Heated Greenhouse Biomass
biomass-steam.description: Steam heat stabilizes controlled growing conditions, allowing reliable year-round biomass production.

basic-battery.name: Voltaic Battery Assembly
basic-battery.description: Zinc supplies the consumable anode, copper carries the cathodic reaction, and dilute sulfuric acid conducts ions inside a simple metal-cased cell.
basic-battery.chemicalFormula: Zn + H₂SO₄ → ZnSO₄ + H₂↑ (Cu as electrode)

sand-crushing.name: Aggregate Sand Crushing
sand-crushing.description: Mechanical crushing reduces ordinary stone to a controlled fine aggregate suitable for glass batches, mortar, and concrete.

limestone-powder.name: Limestone Powder Milling
limestone-powder.description: Fine milling increases the reactive surface area of limestone for faster calcination and more uniform cement raw meal.

cement-production.name: Lime–Clay Cement Mixing
cement-production.description: Powered mixing disperses hydrated lime through siliceous clay to form an early hydraulic binder rather than modern Portland clinker cement.
cement-production.chemicalFormula: 3 Ca(OH)₂ + SiO₂ → Ca₃SiO₅ (3CaO·SiO₂, C3S, alite) + 3 H₂O↑

manual-cement-production.name: Manual Lime–Clay Cement Mixing
manual-cement-production.description: Hand blending combines hydrated lime and fine clay into the same early hydraulic binder, but without powered agitation.
manual-cement-production.chemicalFormula: 3 Ca(OH)₂ + SiO₂ → Ca₃SiO₅ (3CaO·SiO₂, C3S, alite) + 3 H₂O↑

gypsum-cement-production.name: Gypsum-Regulated Lime–Clay Cement
gypsum-cement-production.description: A measured gypsum addition controls early setting reactions in the lime–clay binder and improves its handling during construction.
gypsum-cement-production.chemicalFormula: 3 Ca(OH)₂ + SiO₂ + CaSO₄·2H₂O → Ca₃SiO₅ (C3S, clinker) + CaSO₄·2H₂O + 3 H₂O↑

concrete-production.name: Aggregate Concrete Mixing
concrete-production.description: Powered mixing coats sand and coarse stone with hydrated cement paste, creating a dense composite that hardens as calcium silicates hydrate.

manual-concrete-production.name: Manual Concrete Mixing
manual-concrete-production.description: Hand mixing combines graded aggregate with cement paste, producing ordinary concrete without the consistency of a powered mixer.

gypsum-concrete-production.name: Gypsum-Modified Concrete Mixing
gypsum-concrete-production.description: Controlled sulfate addition promotes ettringite formation in the cement paste, improving early structure when the dosage is kept within safe limits.
gypsum-concrete-production.chemicalFormula: Ca₃Al₂O₆ + 3 CaSO₄·2H₂O + 26 H₂O → Ca₃Al₂O₆·3 CaSO₄·32 H₂O (ettringite)

asphalt-production.name: Asphalt Production
asphalt-production.description: Hot bitumen coats graded stone and sand, forming a compactable paving mixture that resists water ingress and repeated industrial traffic.

hyperdrive-engine.name: Hyperdrive Engine Assembly
hyperdrive-engine.description: Superconducting field coils, exotic-matter containment, quantum control hardware, and refractory structures are integrated into the colony’s faster-than-light propulsion core.
hyperdrive-engine.chemicalFormula: Advanced formula involving quantum tunneling and dark energy manipulation

iron-gear-production.name: Iron Gear Cutting
iron-gear-production.description: Iron plate is marked, cut, and filed into a basic toothed wheel for low-speed mechanical transmissions.

copper-wire-production.name: Copper Wire Drawing
copper-wire-production.description: Successive drawing dies reduce copper plate into long, uniform conductors while work hardening the metal enough for reliable handling.

basic-circuit.name: Electromechanical Control Circuit Assembly
basic-circuit.description: Copper conductors and simple switching components are mounted on a rigid iron support to create an early, low-density control circuit.

electric-motor-production.name: Electric Motor Assembly
electric-motor-production.description: Magnetic cores, copper windings, and gearing are aligned into a compact rotary actuator.

electric-motor-autimatic-production.name: Automated Electric Motor Batch Assembly
electric-motor-autimatic-production.description: Fixtures align steel magnetic parts, copper windings, bearings, and gearing while lubricated handling allows several motors to be assembled in one cycle.

processing-unit-production.name: High-Density Processing Unit Assembly
processing-unit-production.description: Large numbers of semiconductor devices are integrated with memory, control circuitry, sensors, and a multilayer board into a compact computing module.

turbine-blade-production.name: Turbine Blade Manufacturing
turbine-blade-production.description: Steel and aluminum stock is formed, machined, and balanced into aerodynamic blades suitable for converting fluid flow into shaft rotation.

wind-power-generation.name: Wind Power Generation
wind-power-generation.description: Aerodynamic rotor blades capture wind momentum and turn a generator, producing electricity without consuming material fuel.

steel-ingot-production.name: Carbon-Controlled Steel Smelting
steel-ingot-production.description: Iron feedstock is melted with controlled carbon addition, producing a cast steel ingot with lower and more deliberate carbon content than pig iron.

steel-from-wrought-iron.name: Wrought-Iron Cementation Steelmaking
steel-from-wrought-iron.description: Clean wrought iron absorbs a controlled amount of carbon at high temperature, forming more uniform steel with fewer inherited impurities.

electronic-components.name: Transformer Assembly
electronic-components.description: Insulated copper windings around a magnetic core transfer alternating electrical energy between circuits at a controlled voltage ratio.

automated-component-assembly.name: Automated Circuit Batch Assembly
automated-component-assembly.description: Mechanized placement and joining turn basic conductors and metal supports into repeatable batches of early electronic control circuits.

automated-component-fabrication.name: Automated Mixed Component Fabrication
automated-component-fabrication.description: A reconfigurable production cell alternates between circuit assembly and gear cutting, using shared fixtures to repeat both operations efficiently.

basic-chemical-processes.name: Coal Desulfurization
basic-chemical-processes.description: Water washing removes part of the sulfur-bearing mineral fraction from coal, returning cleaner fuel while concentrating sulfur for chemical use.

basic-refining.name: Primary Crude-Oil Conditioning
basic-refining.description: Simple heating removes water and unstable heavy residues from crude oil, producing a broad petroleum feedstock for later refinery separation.

crude-oil-extraction.name: Crude Oil Extraction
crude-oil-extraction.description: A drilled well uses reservoir pressure and mechanical lifting to bring untreated crude oil from a subsurface accumulation to the surface.

industrial-oil-extraction.name: Industrial Crude Oil Extraction
industrial-oil-extraction.description: A dedicated pump maintains greater well drawdown and sustained flow, increasing recovery from the same crude-oil reservoir.

industrial-scale-power.name: Coal-Fired Steam Power Generation
industrial-scale-power.description: Coal heats boiler water and the resulting steam drives an industrial generator, with a smaller steam stream retained for process use.

efficient-industrial-scale-power.name: Transformer-Optimized Coal Power
efficient-industrial-scale-power.description: Improved electrical conversion and grid matching raise generator output from the same coal and boiler-water charge.

petroleum-refining.name: Petroleum Fractionation into Motor Fuels
petroleum-refining.description: Refinery separation divides broad petroleum feedstock into gasoline-range and diesel-range fractions according to volatility.

plastic-production.name: Petroleum-Derived Plastic Production
plastic-production.description: Petroleum hydrocarbons are cracked into smaller olefins and polymerized into moldable plastic feedstock.

lubricant-production.name: Lubricating Oil Blending
lubricant-production.description: Heavy petroleum fractions are purified and blended into viscous oils that separate moving surfaces and limit mechanical wear.
lubricant-production.chemicalFormula: C₂₀H₄₂ (heavy fraction from petroleum) + additives → lubricant oil

advanced-chemicals.name: Petroleum-Heated Contact Process
advanced-chemicals.description: Petroleum firing supplies steady process heat for higher sulfuric acid output in chemical plant equipment.

synthetic-materials.name: Synthetic Rubber Compounding
synthetic-materials.description: Polymer feedstock is chemically modified and compounded into an elastic material suitable for seals, belts, and vibration isolation.

solar-cell-production.name: Framed Solar Cell Assembly
solar-cell-production.description: Photovoltaic cells are interconnected behind a glass cover and fixed to an aluminum backing, forming a protected electrical generating unit.
solar-cell-production.chemicalFormula: Si photovoltaic junction + glass cover + Al backing + insulated Cu wiring → framed solar cell

advanced-solar-panel.name: Aerogel Solar Module Assembly
advanced-solar-panel.description: A lightweight alloy frame seals multiple photovoltaic cells beneath glass, while an aerogel layer limits thermal stress across the module.
advanced-solar-panel.chemicalFormula: PV cells + glass + insulated wiring + Al alloy frame + aerogel layer → solar module

solar-power-generation.name: Solar Power Generation
solar-power-generation.description: Photovoltaic junctions convert incident sunlight directly into electrical current, with no moving parts or consumed fuel.

enhanced-solar-power-generation.name: Enhanced Solar Module Power Generation
enhanced-solar-power-generation.description: Aerogel-backed modules reduce thermal losses and keep photovoltaic cells nearer their efficient operating temperature under strong sunlight.

ultimate-solar-power-generation.name: Utility-Scale Solar Module Generation
ultimate-solar-power-generation.description: A utility-scale field combines many advanced modules through coordinated power electronics to deliver a large, stable solar output.

advanced-glass-production.name: Electric Float Glassmaking
advanced-glass-production.description: Precision electric heating keeps the glass melt uniform enough for clearer, stronger industrial panes.

precision-smelting.name: Electric Iron Oxide Reduction
precision-smelting.description: Tightly controlled electric heating and a reducing furnace atmosphere convert concentrated iron oxide directly into clean plate-grade iron.

precision-voltage-smelting.name: Transformer-Controlled Iron Oxide Reduction
precision-voltage-smelting.description: Transformer regulation holds furnace power and temperature within a narrow range, increasing the yield of plate-grade iron from the same oxide charge.

industrial-heating.name: Oil-Fired Hematite Direct Reduction
industrial-heating.description: Reformed light-oil gases remove oxygen from hematite without melting it, after which the reduced iron is consolidated directly into plates.

large-scale-hydro-generation.name: Reservoir Hydroelectric Generation
large-scale-hydro-generation.description: Stored water descends through pressure conduits and turbines, converting gravitational potential energy into large-scale electrical output.

deep-oil-extraction.name: Hydraulic-Fracturing Oil Extraction
deep-oil-extraction.description: Pressurized water opens low-permeability rock and carries proppant into the fractures, allowing trapped oil to flow toward the well.
deep-oil-extraction.chemicalFormula: H₂O(pressurized) + proppants → expanded rock fractures → crude oil release

natural-gas-extraction.name: Hydraulic-Fracturing Gas Extraction
natural-gas-extraction.description: Hydraulic fractures connect gas-filled pores to the wellbore, releasing methane-rich natural gas from otherwise impermeable formations.

steam-methane-reforming.name: Steam Methane Reforming
steam-methane-reforming.description: High-temperature steam converts methane into carbon monoxide and hydrogen-rich synthesis gas, from which hydrogen is separated for industrial use.

geothermal-heat-capture.name: Geothermal Steam Power Generation
geothermal-heat-capture.description: Circulating water collects heat from deep rock and returns as steam to drive a turbine before the fluid is reinjected.

industrial-wood-processing.name: Mechanized Logging Operations
industrial-wood-processing.description: Powered felling, delimbing, and forwarding equipment turns managed forest stands into a continuous high-volume timber supply.

industrial-diamond-production.name: HPHT Industrial Diamond Synthesis
industrial-diamond-production.description: High pressure and high temperature dissolve graphite in a catalyst metal, allowing diamond crystals to nucleate and grow under controlled conditions.

precision-alloy-formation.name: Vacuum Precision Alloying
precision-alloy-formation.description: Vacuum melting limits oxidation while controlled mixing and thermal cycling form clean batches of advanced and shape-memory alloys.

high-purity-metals.name: Induction Steel Plate Refining
high-purity-metals.description: Induction heating gives tight thermal control for converting clean iron feedstock into high-purity steel plate.
high-purity-metals.chemicalFormula: Fe(98%) + C + electromagnetic energy → Fe(99.9%) + C

large-scale-ore-extraction.name: Bulk Industrial Ore Extraction
large-scale-ore-extraction.description: High-capacity drilling, blasting, loading, and haulage recover large mixed batches of the colony’s principal ores and industrial minerals.

rare-mineral-mining.name: Selective Rare-Mineral Extraction
rare-mineral-mining.description: Targeted drilling and sensor sorting recover small but valuable streams of specialty ores from complex industrial-mine workings.

robotic-mining-operations.name: Autonomous Robotic Mining Campaign
robotic-mining-operations.description: A robotic mining platform coordinates cutting, loading, and ore sorting through a long unattended campaign, using replaceable steel tooling for sustained production.

cobaltite-processing.name: Oxidative Cobaltite Roasting
cobaltite-processing.description: An oxygen-rich roast converts cobalt sulfarsenide into cobalt oxide while arsenic and sulfur leave in captured volatile byproducts.

cobalt-oxide-reduction.name: Carbothermic Cobalt Oxide Reduction
cobalt-oxide-reduction.description: Carbon removes oxygen from cobalt oxide at furnace temperature, producing metallic cobalt suitable for alloying.

research-data-processing.name: GRID Research Data Contract
research-data-processing.description: Laboratory electronics validate and encrypt industrial datasets for GRID contracts, which return standardized advanced circuitry as compensation.

fiberglass-production.name: Glass-Fiber Composite Manufacturing
fiberglass-production.description: Molten glass is drawn into fine filaments and combined with a polymer binder to form strong, lightweight fiberglass stock.
fiberglass-production.chemicalFormula: SiO₂(melted) + B₂O₃ + CaO + filament extrusion → glass fiber

carbon-fiber-production.name: Polymer-Precursor Carbon Fiber Production
carbon-fiber-production.description: Carbon-rich polymer filaments are spun, stabilized, and heated without oxygen until most non-carbon atoms leave and high-strength carbon fibers remain.

advanced-composites.name: Hybrid Fiber-Reinforced Material Fabrication
advanced-composites.description: Carbon fiber supplies stiffness while glass fiber improves toughness and cost efficiency inside a consolidated polymer matrix.
advanced-composites.chemicalFormula: (≡C-C≡)ₙ + SiO₂ fibers + polymer matrix → composite material

nuclear-fuel-processing.name: Nuclear Fuel Assembly Fabrication
nuclear-fuel-processing.description: Enriched uranium dioxide is formed into fuel elements and secured with oxidation-resistant Inconel hardware for stable reactor loading.
nuclear-fuel-processing.chemicalFormula: enriched UO₂ pellets + Inconel alloy hardware → nuclear fuel assembly

thorium-fuel-cell.name: Thorium Fuel Assembly Fabrication
thorium-fuel-cell.description: Thorium dioxide fuel is combined with enriched-uranium driver material and heat-resistant Inconel hardware to form a reactor-ready assembly.
thorium-fuel-cell.chemicalFormula: ThO₂ + enriched UO₂ + Inconel hardware → thorium fuel assembly

quantum-data-analysis.name: NEXUS Quantum Compute Contract
quantum-data-analysis.description: Rent quantum laboratory compute capacity to NEXUS and receive processing units as a corporate fulfillment reward

exotic-matter-synthesis.name: Exotic Matter Synthesis
exotic-matter-synthesis.description: Quantum confinement and precisely controlled fields force supplied matter into metastable states with properties unavailable in ordinary bulk materials.
exotic-matter-synthesis.chemicalFormula: Fermions + bosons + quantum confinement → exotic matter states

automated-quantum-experiments.name: Automated Quantum Experiments
automated-quantum-experiments.description: Robotic stations maintain delicate quantum apparatus through long experimental cycles with fewer human interruptions.

fusion-reaction-control.name: Hydrogen Plasma Fusion Power
fusion-reaction-control.description: Magnetic confinement maintains an ultra-hot hydrogen plasma long enough for fusion reactions to release more energy than the control systems consume.

deuterium-fusion-reaction.name: Deuterium–Deuterium Fusion Power
deuterium-fusion-reaction.description: Deuterium nuclei fuse through neutron- and proton-producing branches, releasing high-energy particles whose heat is converted into electricity.

high-energy-plasma-containment.name: Exotic-Matter Plasma Synthesis
high-energy-plasma-containment.description: Extreme magnetic confinement drives a high-energy plasma into rare non-equilibrium states, allowing a minute amount of exotic matter to be isolated.
high-energy-plasma-containment.chemicalFormula: H(ionized) + magnetic confinement → plasma (10⁸K) + neutron radiation

pyrite-mining.name: Pyrite Mining
pyrite-mining.description: Follow deep iron-sulfide veins and separate dense pyrite from ordinary wall rock for sulfur recovery and iron-oxide roasting.

nickel-ore-mining.name: Nickel Ore Mining
nickel-ore-mining.description: Deep selective workings recover nickel-bearing sulfides while rejecting enough host rock to keep later matte smelting practical.

chromite-mining.name: Chromite Mining
chromite-mining.description: Recover dense chromite from deep ultramafic seams as the primary chromium-bearing feed for ferrochrome smelting.

ilmenite-mining.name: Ilmenite Mining
ilmenite-mining.description: Heavy-mineral deposits are worked selectively to concentrate titanium-bearing ilmenite before chloride-route processing.

rare-earth-mineral-extraction.name: Monazite Rare-Earth Ore Extraction
rare-earth-mineral-extraction.description: Chemical-assisted mining frees and concentrates monazite from resistant host material, preserving the phosphate mineral for controlled rare-earth refining.

air-extraction.name: Atmospheric Air Compression
air-extraction.description: Large compressors draw ambient air through filters and deliver a clean, pressurized feed for cryogenic separation.
air-extraction.chemicalFormula: N₂(78%) + O₂(21%) + Ar(0.9%) + trace gases → compressed air

air-liquefaction.name: Cryogenic Air Liquefaction
air-liquefaction.description: Repeated compression, heat exchange, and expansion cool filtered air below its condensation range to produce liquid air.

fractional-distillation.name: Cryogenic Air Fractionation
fractional-distillation.description: A distillation column exploits the different boiling points of nitrogen, argon, and oxygen to separate liquid air into purified gas streams.

hydrogen-production.name: Water Electrolysis for Hydrogen
hydrogen-production.description: Electric current splits water at paired electrodes, producing hydrogen at the cathode and oxygen at the anode.

pyrite-processing.name: Oxidative Pyrite Roasting
pyrite-processing.description: Roasting pyrite in oxygen converts iron into oxide and sulfur into sulfur dioxide, which is then captured for industrial sulfur recovery.

nickel-ore-processing.name: Nickel Matte Smelting
nickel-ore-processing.description: Smelting removes gangue and part of the sulfur from nickel ore, concentrating the remaining nickel sulfides into a matte phase.

nickel-refining.name: Electrolytic Nickel Matte Refining
nickel-refining.description: Acidic electrorefining transfers nickel from processed matte into high-purity cathode metal suitable for corrosion-resistant alloys.

chromite-processing.name: Carbothermic Ferrochrome Smelting
chromite-processing.description: A high-temperature electric smelt reduces chromite with coke while limestone binds gangue, producing ferrochrome for chromium-bearing alloys.

chromium-refining.name: Electrolytic Chromium Refining
chromium-refining.description: Electrochemical separation removes iron from ferrochrome and deposits high-purity chromium metal for controlled alloying.

ilmenite-processing.name: Ilmenite Carbochlorination
ilmenite-processing.description: Chlorine and carbon convert the titanium fraction of ilmenite into volatile titanium tetrachloride, leaving an iron-rich oxide residue.

titanium-reduction.name: Kroll Process Titanium Reduction
titanium-reduction.description: Magnesium reduces purified titanium tetrachloride in a sealed hot vessel, forming porous titanium sponge and recyclable magnesium chloride.

magnesium-chloride-electrolysis.name: Molten Magnesium Chloride Electrolysis
magnesium-chloride-electrolysis.description: Electrolysis of molten magnesium chloride deposits magnesium metal at the cathode and releases chlorine at the anode for reuse.

titanium-purification.name: Vacuum-Arc Titanium Remelting
titanium-purification.description: Vacuum-arc remelting consolidates porous titanium sponge into dense ingots while limiting oxygen and nitrogen contamination.

high-temperature-processing.name: Fuel-Assisted Titanium Sponge Consolidation
high-temperature-processing.description: Kerosene supplies indirect furnace preheat while the protected electric hot zone consolidates reactive titanium sponge into ingots without exposing the melt to combustion gases.

offshore-oil-extraction.name: Offshore Oil Extraction
offshore-oil-extraction.description: Subsea wellheads, risers, and platform pumps lift crude oil from reservoirs beneath the seabed into a continuous offshore production stream.

crude-oil-distillation.name: Atmospheric Crude-Oil Fractionation
crude-oil-distillation.description: A refinery column separates heated crude oil by boiling range into naphtha, middle distillates, heavy oil, and residual bitumen.

catalytic-cracking.name: Fluid Catalytic Cracking of Heavy Oil
catalytic-cracking.description: Hot porous catalyst breaks large heavy-oil hydrocarbons into lighter fuel-range molecules before most of the catalyst is regenerated and recirculated.

petroleum-coke-production.name: Delayed Coking of Heavy Oil
petroleum-coke-production.description: Severe thermal cracking converts residual heavy oil into solid petroleum coke while recovering a smaller stream of lighter hydrocarbons.

limestone-calcination.name: Limestone Calcination
limestone-calcination.description: Controlled heating drives carbon dioxide out of limestone, leaving reactive quicklime for lime chemistry.

enhanced-lime-calcination.name: Fine-Feed Limestone Calcination
enhanced-lime-calcination.description: Powdered limestone exposes more surface area to kiln heat, accelerating carbon-dioxide removal and improving quicklime yield.

lime-slaking.name: Lime Slaking
lime-slaking.description: Quicklime is hydrated into slaked lime, a safer and more workable material for binders and chemistry.

chloralkali-process.name: Membrane Chlor-Alkali Electrolysis
chloralkali-process.description: Electrolysis of purified brine produces chlorine at the anode, hydrogen at the cathode, and a separated stream of caustic soda.

haber-process.name: Haber–Bosch Ammonia Synthesis
haber-process.description: Compressed nitrogen and hydrogen approach equilibrium over a promoted catalyst at elevated temperature, producing ammonia for industrial chemistry.

high-throughput-chemical-synthesis.name: Integrated Sulfuric Acid and Hydrogen Production
high-throughput-chemical-synthesis.description: Coordinated contact-process and water-electrolysis sections share heat, power conditioning, and automated controls to deliver sulfuric acid and hydrogen at high throughput.

nitric-acid-production.name: Ostwald Process Nitric Acid
nitric-acid-production.description: Catalytic ammonia oxidation forms nitrogen oxides that are further oxidized and absorbed in water to produce nitric acid.

hydrochloric-acid-production.name: Direct-Synthesis Hydrochloric Acid
hydrochloric-acid-production.description: Hydrogen burns in chlorine to form hydrogen chloride gas, which is cooled and absorbed in water to produce concentrated hydrochloric acid.

phosphoric-acid-production.name: Wet-Process Phosphoric Acid
phosphoric-acid-production.description: Sulfuric acid digests phosphate rock, releasing phosphoric acid while calcium precipitates as gypsum.

catalyst-production.name: Supported-Metal Catalyst Fabrication
catalyst-production.description: Nickel, cobalt, and trace platinum are dispersed across porous silica gel to create a high-area catalyst for demanding chemical reactions.
catalyst-production.chemicalFormula: Ni + Co + SiO₂ + Pt → Ni/Co/Pt on silica support

silica-gel-production.name: Precipitated Silica Gel Production
silica-gel-production.description: Quartz is converted into soluble sodium silicate, then acidified so a porous hydrated-silica network precipitates as gel.

stainless-steel-production.name: Austenitic Stainless Steel Alloying
stainless-steel-production.description: Chromium establishes a self-healing passive oxide film while nickel stabilizes a tough austenitic structure in the steel.

high-carbon-steel-production.name: High-Carbon Steelmaking
high-carbon-steel-production.description: Controlled carbon addition raises the carbon content of molten steel, producing a harder grade suitable for wear-resistant components.

tool-steel-production.name: Cobalt–Chromium–Molybdenum Tool Steel
tool-steel-production.description: Chromium, molybdenum, and cobalt are alloyed into high-carbon steel to retain hardness, wear resistance, and cutting strength at elevated temperature.
tool-steel-production.chemicalFormula: Fe + C(>0.8%) + Cr + Mo + Co → Fe-C-Cr-Mo-Co alloy

nichrome-production.name: Nichrome Resistance Alloying
nichrome-production.description: Nickel and chromium are induction-melted into an oxidation-resistant alloy whose stable electrical resistance suits heating elements.

titanium-alloy-production.name: Ti-6Al-4V Titanium Alloying
titanium-alloy-production.description: Aluminum and vanadium stabilize complementary phases in titanium, producing a strong, light alloy with useful fatigue and heat resistance.

aluminum-alloy-production.name: Aluminum–Copper–Magnesium Alloying
aluminum-alloy-production.description: Copper enables precipitation hardening while a small magnesium addition improves strength without sacrificing the low mass of aluminum.

shape-memory-alloy-production.name: Nitinol Shape-Memory Alloying
shape-memory-alloy-production.description: Near-equiatomic nickel and titanium form a reversible martensitic alloy that can recover a programmed shape after deformation.

pig-iron-plate-rolling.name: Pig-Iron Plate Rolling
pig-iron-plate-rolling.description: Powered rolls flatten cast pig iron into usable plate stock, with brittle edges and surface defects removed as scrap.

wrought-iron-plate-rolling.name: Wrought-Iron Plate Rolling
wrought-iron-plate-rolling.description: The low-carbon, fibrous structure of wrought iron tolerates heavy deformation, yielding more clean plate from each refined charge.

blister-copper-rolling.name: Blister-Copper Plate Rolling
blister-copper-rolling.description: Repeated hot rolling closes casting voids and forms blister copper into uniform plate while trimming oxidized edges as scrap.

electrolytic-copper-to-plate-rolling.name: High-Purity Copper Plate Rolling
electrolytic-copper-to-plate-rolling.description: Controlled rolling converts exceptionally pure electrolytic copper into dense plate while preserving the conductivity needed for advanced electrical equipment.

lead-plate-rolling.name: Lead Plate Rolling
lead-plate-rolling.description: Low-temperature rolling flattens soft lead ingots into dense, uniform plate for battery electrodes and radiation-absorbing assemblies.

steel-plate-rolling.name: Steel Plate Rolling
steel-plate-rolling.description: Successive reductions between powered rolls turn steel ingots into consistent plate stock while offcuts and scale leave as recoverable scrap.

aluminum-plate-rolling.name: Aluminum Plate Rolling
aluminum-plate-rolling.description: Controlled rolling exploits aluminum’s ductility to form light, uniform plate while segregating edge trim as recoverable scrap.

precision-wire-drawing.name: Precision Copper Wire Drawing
precision-wire-drawing.description: Copper is pulled through progressively smaller dies, work-hardening into dimensionally consistent wire for electrical fabrication.

nichrome-wire-production.name: Nichrome Wire Drawing
nichrome-wire-production.description: Progressive die drawing forms nichrome into uniform resistance wire while preserving the alloy surface needed for durable heating elements.

insulated-wire-production.name: Polymer-Insulated Wire Production
insulated-wire-production.description: Plastic provides the primary dielectric jacket while rubber improves flexibility and strain relief around the copper conductor.
insulated-wire-production.chemicalFormula: Cu wire + polymer/rubber dielectric → insulated Cu conductor

bitumen-insulated-wire-production.name: Bitumen-Impregnated Cable Production
bitumen-insulated-wire-production.description: A plastic dielectric isolates the conductor, and bitumen impregnation adds a water-resistant outer barrier for harsh industrial service.
bitumen-insulated-wire-production.chemicalFormula: Cu wire + plastic dielectric + bitumen waterproofing → waterproof insulated cable

cast-iron-production.name: Cast-Iron Mold Casting
cast-iron-production.description: Molten pig iron fills refractory-lined molds and solidifies into reusable cast-iron stock, with runners and imperfect edges recovered as scrap.

cast-iron-gear.name: Cast-Iron Gear Casting
cast-iron-gear.description: Dedicated molds form molten cast iron close to the final tooth profile, reducing machining while producing sturdy general-purpose gears.

cast-iron-high-pressure-pipes.name: Cast Iron Pipe Casting
cast-iron-high-pressure-pipes.description: Dedicated molds form molten cast iron into repeatable pipe sections, while refractory tooling survives the casting temperature and is retained for reuse.

precision-casting.name: Precision Steel Gear Casting
precision-casting.description: Dimensionally stable refractory molds cast steel near its final gear geometry, minimizing finishing losses and preserving accurate tooth profiles.

high-precision-casting.name: Precision Hydraulic Cylinder Manufacturing
high-precision-casting.description: Silica-derived precision molds establish the aluminum-alloy body, while steel, seals, and lubricant complete tightly fitted hydraulic cylinders.
high-precision-casting.chemicalFormula: Al alloy(liquid) + ceramic mold + pressure → Al alloy(intricate shape)

metal-foam-production.name: Gas-Foamed Aluminum–Titanium Casting
metal-foam-production.description: Dispersed hydrogen expands inside a controlled aluminum–titanium melt before cooling locks the bubbles into a light cellular metal.
metal-foam-production.chemicalFormula: Al-Ti(liquid) + H₂ gas + controlled cooling → Al-Ti(foam)

copper-plating.name: Copper Electroplating
copper-plating.description: An electrolytic bath dissolves copper feed and deposits a thin conductive copper layer uniformly across prepared iron plates.

chrome-plating.name: Chromium Electroplating
chrome-plating.description: Electrolytic deposition places a hard chromium finish on prepared steel, improving surface wear and corrosion resistance.

stainless-steel-passivation.name: Nitric-Acid Stainless Steel Passivation
stainless-steel-passivation.description: Nitric acid removes free iron from the stainless surface and promotes a chromium-rich passive film without adding a separate metal coating.
stainless-steel-passivation.chemicalFormula: Fe-Cr-Ni + HNO₃ → Fe-Cr-Ni with Cr₂O₃ passive layer

nickel-plating.name: Nickel Electroplating
nickel-plating.description: An electrolytic bath deposits nickel uniformly over prepared iron, forming a dense barrier against oxidation and chemical attack.

silicon-purification.name: Chloride-Route Semiconductor Silicon Purification
silicon-purification.description: Metallurgical silicon is converted into volatile silicon tetrachloride, purified by distillation, and reduced with hydrogen to deposit semiconductor-grade silicon.

salt-water-processing.name: Brine Evaporation and Halite Recovery
salt-water-processing.description: Controlled evaporation removes water as reusable steam until sodium chloride crystallizes from the concentrated brine as halite.

unshielded-silicon-crystal-growing.name: Czochralski Silicon Growth without Inert Atmosphere
unshielded-silicon-crystal-growing.description: A seed crystal is withdrawn from molten semiconductor-grade silicon without inert shielding, forming a single-crystal boule with substantial oxidation losses.
unshielded-silicon-crystal-growing.chemicalFormula: Si(molten) + seed crystal + rotation → Si(single crystal)

silicon-crystal-growing.name: Argon-Atmosphere Czochralski Silicon Growth
silicon-crystal-growing.description: The Czochralski process draws a rotating seed from molten silicon under argon, suppressing oxidation and stabilizing single-crystal growth.
silicon-crystal-growing.chemicalFormula: Si(molten) + seed crystal + rotation + Ar(shield) → Si(single crystal)

wafer-slicing.name: Precision Silicon Wafer Slicing
wafer-slicing.description: A precision saw sections a monocrystalline boule into thin parallel wafers whose flatness supports later lithography and device fabrication.

photoresist-production.name: Lithographic Photoresist Formulation
photoresist-production.description: A film-forming polymer is blended with petroleum-derived solvent and photosensitive chemistry to create a coating whose solubility changes under patterned light.

unshielded-integrated-circuit-fabricatio.name: Planar Integrated-Circuit Fabrication without Inert Atmosphere
unshielded-integrated-circuit-fabricatio.description: Planar doping, patterning, etching, and metallization form multiple devices on each wafer, but exposure to air lowers usable circuit yield.
unshielded-integrated-circuit-fabricatio.chemicalFormula: Si + photoresist + etching + doping → integrated circuit

integrated-circuit-fabrication.name: Argon-Atmosphere Integrated-Circuit Fabrication
integrated-circuit-fabrication.description: Planar wafer processing under argon limits contamination during doping, patterning, etching, and metallization, sharply improving circuit yield.
integrated-circuit-fabrication.chemicalFormula: Si + photoresist + etching + doping + Ar(shield) → integrated circuit

microprocessor-fabrication.name: Microprocessor Die Fabrication and Packaging
microprocessor-fabrication.description: Dense transistor logic and supporting integrated blocks are patterned, interconnected, tested, and sealed into ceramic packages with fine gold connections.

resistor-production.name: Carbon-Film Resistor Manufacturing
resistor-production.description: A controlled carbon resistive path is formed on an insulating ceramic body and terminated with copper leads to create repeatable circuit resistance.
resistor-production.chemicalFormula: C + metal oxides + wires → resistive element

capacitor-production.name: Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitor Manufacturing
capacitor-production.description: An anodized aluminum electrode supplies a thin dielectric layer, while electrolyte, insulation, and terminals complete a compact charge-storage component.

transistor-production.name: Planar Transistor Fabrication
transistor-production.description: Photolithography and selective doping define adjoining semiconductor regions before fine gold contacts connect thousands of discrete switching devices.
transistor-production.chemicalFormula: Si + p-type dopant + n-type dopant + Au + Ar(shield) → p-n-p/n-p-n junction with Au contacts

low-contact-diode-production.name: Base-Metal Contact Diode Fabrication
low-contact-diode-production.description: Selective doping forms p–n junctions across a silicon wafer, while economical copper contacts provide a practical early diode with modest batch yield.
low-contact-diode-production.chemicalFormula: Si + p-type dopant + n-type dopant → p-n junction

diode-production.name: Silver-Contact Diode Fabrication
diode-production.description: Controlled junction formation and low-resistance silver contacts improve electrical consistency and allow far more usable diodes per wafer.
diode-production.chemicalFormula: Si + p-type dopant + n-type dopant + Ag → p-n junction with Ag contacts

pcb-manufacturing.name: Subtractive Printed-Circuit Board Manufacturing
pcb-manufacturing.description: Photoresist protects a patterned copper layer while exposed metal is etched away, leaving conductive traces on an insulating polymer substrate.
pcb-manufacturing.chemicalFormula: Cu clad + photoresist + FeCl₃ etch → Cu traces on substrate

pcb-manufacturing-nitric.name: Nitric Acid PCB Etching
pcb-manufacturing-nitric.description: Nitric acid sharpens copper etch control for cleaner traces and more reliable printed circuit boards.
pcb-manufacturing-nitric.chemicalFormula: Cu clad + photoresist + HNO₃ etch → Cu traces on substrate

phosphoric-pcb-etching.name: Phosphoric-Acid PCB Etching
phosphoric-pcb-etching.description: A phosphoric-acid etch removes exposed copper under controlled conditions, producing clean trace geometry with less undercutting and board waste.
phosphoric-pcb-etching.chemicalFormula: Cu clad + photoresist + H₃PO₄ etch → Cu traces on substrate

advanced-circuit-assembly.name: Advanced Circuit Board Component Assembly
advanced-circuit-assembly.description: Semiconductor packages and passive components are positioned, electrically joined, and inspected on a prepared PCB to form a complete advanced control board.

advanced-circuit-automatics.name: Automated Advanced Circuit Manufacturing
advanced-circuit-automatics.description: Machine-guided placement, precision interconnection, and automated inspection raise throughput while maintaining alignment across densely populated advanced boards.

carbon-nanotube-synthesis.name: Catalytic Carbon Nanotube Growth
carbon-nanotube-synthesis.description: A vaporized carbon feed decomposes on nanoscale catalyst sites, where carbon precipitates into cylindrical graphitic walls rather than bulk graphite.

aerogel-production.name: Supercritical Silica Aerogel Drying
aerogel-production.description: Solvent exchange followed by supercritical drying removes liquid from silica gel without capillary collapse, preserving an exceptionally light porous solid.

ceramic-matrix-composite-production.name: Nanotube-Reinforced Silicon-Carbide Composite
ceramic-matrix-composite-production.description: Silicon-carbide phases are sintered around dispersed carbon nanotubes, combining high-temperature ceramic stability with improved crack resistance.
ceramic-matrix-composite-production.chemicalFormula: SiC + CNTs + sintering → SiC matrix with CNT reinforcement

metal-matrix-composite-production.name: Aluminum–Silicon-Carbide Metal-Matrix Composite
metal-matrix-composite-production.description: Ceramic silicon-carbide particles are distributed through molten aluminum alloy and pressure-cast into a light material with greater stiffness and wear resistance.
metal-matrix-composite-production.chemicalFormula: Al(molten) + SiC particles + pressure casting → Al-SiC composite

uranium-ore-processing.name: Acid Leaching of Uraninite to Yellowcake
uranium-ore-processing.description: Oxidizing sulfuric-acid leaching dissolves uranium from crushed uraninite, after which the uranium is concentrated and precipitated as yellowcake.

uranium-purex-processing.name: Spent Fuel PUREX Reprocessing
uranium-purex-processing.description: Dissolve spent nuclear fuel in nitric acid and separate reusable uranium and plutonium through PUREX solvent extraction
uranium-purex-processing.chemicalFormula: spent UO₂ fuel + HNO₃ + TBP solvent extraction → U compounds + Pu compounds + fission-product raffinate

uranium-hexafluoride-production.name: Uranium Hexafluoride Conversion
uranium-hexafluoride-production.description: Converts yellowcake into volatile UF₆ gas suitable for centrifuge enrichment.

uranium-centrifuge-enrichment.name: Gas-Centrifuge Uranium Enrichment
uranium-centrifuge-enrichment.description: A cascade of high-speed centrifuges separates uranium hexafluoride by isotope mass, concentrating uranium-235 while producing depleted UF₆ tails.

hazardous-materials-processing.name: Robotic Gas-Centrifuge Enrichment
hazardous-materials-processing.description: Shielded robots service a larger UF₆ centrifuge cascade, maintaining precise operation while limiting worker exposure to radioactive and chemically hazardous material.
hazardous-materials-processing.chemicalFormula: UF₆ feed + robotic centrifuge handling → enriched UF₆ + depleted UF₆ tails

depleted-uranium-processing.name: Depleted UF₆ Deconversion
depleted-uranium-processing.description: Hydrogen and steam deconvert depleted UF₆ tails into stable depleted uranium oxide while recovering fluorine content as hydrofluoric acid.

hydrogen-sulfide-synthesis.name: Direct Hydrogen Sulfide Synthesis
hydrogen-sulfide-synthesis.description: Elemental sulfur reacts directly with hydrogen under controlled heating to supply hydrogen sulfide for isotope-exchange chemistry.

hydrogen-sulfide-from-pyrite.name: Acid Decomposition of Pyrite
hydrogen-sulfide-from-pyrite.description: Hydrochloric acid attacks pyrite and liberates hydrogen sulfide while the iron-bearing residue is recovered for oxide processing.

heavy-water-production.name: Girdler Sulfide Heavy-Water Enrichment
heavy-water-production.description: Countercurrent isotope exchange between water and hydrogen sulfide concentrates deuterium through repeated hot and cold stages, yielding a small heavy-water stream.

deuterium-extraction.name: Heavy-Water Electrolysis for Deuterium
deuterium-extraction.description: Electrolysis splits deuterium oxide into deuterium gas at the cathode and oxygen at the anode for use in fusion systems.

e-waste-phosphoric-leaching.name: Phosphoric-Acid E-Waste Leaching
e-waste-phosphoric-leaching.description: Phosphoric acid dissolves accessible base-metal phases from shredded electronics, allowing copper, tin, silicon-bearing material, and polymers to be separated.
e-waste-phosphoric-leaching.chemicalFormula: E-waste + H₃PO₄ → Cu₃(PO₄)₂ + AgPO₄ + FePO₄ + other metal phosphates

e-waste-dual-acid-extraction.name: Sequential Phosphoric–Nitric E-Waste Leaching
e-waste-dual-acid-extraction.description: Phosphoric leaching removes bulk material before nitric acid attacks more resistant metallic phases, broadening recovery to precious and specialty metals.
e-waste-dual-acid-extraction.chemicalFormula: E-waste + H₃PO₄ + HNO₃ → Cu₃(PO₄)₂ + Ag(dissolved) + Au(particles) + other compounds

e-waste-aqua-regia-extraction.name: Aqua Regia Precious-Metal Recovery from E-Waste
e-waste-aqua-regia-extraction.description: After phosphoric pretreatment, nitric and hydrochloric acids form aqua regia that dissolves noble metals for selective recovery from complex electronic residues.
e-waste-aqua-regia-extraction.chemicalFormula: E-waste + H₃PO₄ (pretreat) + HNO₃ + 3HCl → H[AuCl₄] + metal chlorides/nitrates/phosphates

robotic-e-waste-phosphoric-processing.name: Robotic E-Waste Dismantling and Hydrometallurgy
robotic-e-waste-phosphoric-processing.description: Robots remove reusable boards and packages before staged acid separation recovers metals from the remaining fraction without sacrificing intact components.
robotic-e-waste-phosphoric-processing.chemicalFormula: E-waste + robotic disassembly + acid separation → recovered metals + reusable components

advanced-scrap-processing.name: Hydrometallurgical Metal-Scrap Recovery
advanced-scrap-processing.description: Acid leaching and selective separation recover a broad mixture of ferrous and nonferrous metals from contaminated industrial scrap while isolating residual slag.

complete-scrap-recycling.name: Multi-Acid Metal-Scrap Separation
complete-scrap-recycling.description: Nitric and hydrochloric acid dissolve complementary metal groups, enabling near-complete selective recovery of ferrous and nonferrous constituents from sorted scrap.

robotic-scrap-processing.name: Robotic Scrap Sorting and Hydrometallurgy
robotic-scrap-processing.description: Robotic identification and dismantling separate alloy families before sulfuric-acid leaching recovers a wide range of clean industrial metals.

basic-scrap-processing.name: Crude Scrap Remelting
basic-scrap-processing.description: Unsorted metal scrap is remelted with minimal separation, recovering only the easiest iron- and copper-rich fractions while most contaminants enter slag.

improved-scrap-processing.name: Fluxed Scrap Remelting
improved-scrap-processing.description: Limestone flux captures more oxides and impurities during remelting, improving recovery of iron, copper, and aluminum from mixed scrap.

bitumen-fuel-processing.name: Bitumen Coking and Light-Oil Recovery
bitumen-fuel-processing.description: Thermal cracking drives lighter hydrocarbons from bitumen and leaves a carbon-rich coke suitable for high-temperature fuel use.

slag-processing.name: Slag Crushing and Mineral Recovery
slag-processing.description: Grinding and physical separation expose entrained iron oxide, lime-rich phases, and silicate material that remained locked inside metallurgical slag.
slag-processing.chemicalFormula: Metallurgical slag + grinding + separation → metal oxides + silicates

tidal-power-generation.name: Tidal-Stream Power Generation
tidal-power-generation.description: Submerged turbines convert the predictable horizontal flow of rising and falling tides into continuous electrical generation.
tidal-power-generation.chemicalFormula: H₂O(tidal potential energy) → H₂O(kinetic energy) → electricity

antimatter-production.name: Particle-Antiparticle Pair Production
antimatter-production.description: Extreme collision energy creates particle–antiparticle pairs, after which electromagnetic traps isolate the tiny antimatter fraction before it contacts ordinary matter.

antimatter-energy-extraction.name: Controlled Antimatter Annihilation Power Generation
